article.title: The Patrick Melrose novels
article.excerpt: I usually find “derelict fiction” unappealing (I don’t for instance enjoy Trainspotting , although I admit its aesthetic merits, nor did I like Drugstore Cowboy ; someone should write an essay on the merits and demerits of drug-based fiction), but these books are for me compulsively readable and the prose is more vital than almost anything else being written
